# Hardware Reliability

## Overview
This wiki page covers [hardware](./hardware.md) reliability considerations, specifically focusing on capacitive soil probe corrosion, longevity of budget [sensors](./sensors.md), and evaluation of replacement options like the [SenseNode SN-400](./sensenode-sn-400.md) and [Aurora](./aurora-labs.md) beta probes.

## Key Details
- **Cheap Probes:** Standard cheap capacitive [soil probes](./soil-probes.md) typically fail within 6 to 9 months when deployed in acidic soil environments.
- **SenseNode SN-400:** Utilizes a coated probe design to mitigate corrosion issues. Replacement parts are available for $12.
- **[Aurora Beta Probe](./aurora-labs.md):** Features a gold-flashed PCB design, though long-term field testing data remains untested.
